text: 中国央行公布2026年9月中央银行各项工具流动性投放情况。中央银行贷款方面，常备借贷便利（SLF）净投放2亿元；中期借贷便利（MLF）净投放2000亿元，抵押补充贷款（PSL）净回笼14亿元；公开市场业务方面，7天期逆回购净回笼860亿元，公开国债买卖净投放1000亿元。
text_en: The PBOC released the liquidity injection situation for various central bank instruments in September 2026. In terms of central bank lending, the standing lending facility (SLF) recorded a net injection of RMB 200 million; the medium-term lending facility (MLF) recorded a net injection of RMB 200 billion, and pledged supplementary lending (PSL) recorded a net withdrawal of RMB 1.4 billion; in terms of open market operations, 7-day reverse repos recorded a net withdrawal of RMB 86 billion, and outright outright outright purchases of government bonds recorded a net injection of RMB 100 billion.
